Summary: The second coming is Christ's promised return in glory to judge the living and the dead, defeat evil, and make all things new. Scripture urges believers not to speculate idly about dates but to watch, work, and encourage one another as the day approaches. His return is the blessed hope that steadies Christians in every trial.
KeyPassages: Matthew 24:30-31; John 14:1-3; Acts 1:11; 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17; Titus 2:13; Revelation 22:20
RelatedDoctrines: Second Coming; Eschatology; Resurrection of the Dead; Final Judgment
RelatedQuestions: When will Jesus return?; What will happen when Jesus comes back?
